Hi all —

I've taken a first pass on the MSA intake and noted items we'll typically flag from the counterparty. High-level notes below (attached: "Nebula_MSA_v1_redlines.pdf" contains inline comments and proposed disposition).

Top flags to watch for (initial):
- Data residency / subprocessing: if Nebula requires EU-only hosting, we need to map that to available regions and separate pricing.
- Liability cap & indemnity carve-outs: expect procurement to request higher caps and vendor-friendly indemnities; we'll propose a tradeoff matrix in the redline.
- IP / output ownership: clarify whether Nebula expects assignment of model outputs — usually we limit to a license back to the customer for their data and outputs.
- Payment terms: 30 days net standard for AE motions; longer nets require finance approval.

Please confirm: do you have an internal contact for SOC2 access (we'll provide via a secure link once an NDA is in place), and does procurement have a preferred contract owner at Nebula (name/email)?

I left a handful of inline comments where we want counterparty to propose alternate language rather than just striking. Marissa — please coordinate the intake call and ask Ariela for the procurement timeline so we can prioritize the liability review.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
